inlines.v: DISPROPORTIONATENESS, noun Unsuitably with respect to form, quantity or value; inadequately; unequally. DISPROPORTIONATE, adjective Not proportioned; unsymmetrical; unsuitable to something else, in bulk, form or value; inadequate. In a perfect form of the body, none of the limbs are disproportionate. It is wisdom not to undertake a work with disproportionate means.
